nodes.description: Payable constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner = msg.sender, credits the full supply to the owner and grants unlimited allowance to the router address.
Public payable transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal whitelist gate: returns true for owner, router, computed pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise defers to condition().
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance, balances and _onSaleNum without SafeMath and emits Transfer.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
Internal sales-limit check against _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and per-address _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an unchecked delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only initializer of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum; declared returns(bool) but has no return statement.
Owner-only batch distribution: computes total = _value * _tos.length, debits msg.sender and credits each recipient, emitting two Transfer events of _value/2.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Internal pure Uniswap-V2 pair address derivation using CREATE2 keccak hashing.
Private mapping tracking how many sale transfers each address has performed.
Private mapping of addresses automatically whitelisted in ensure().
Private minimum sale amount enforced by condition().
Private maximum sale amount enforced by condition().
Private number of sales allowed per address, enforced via _onSaleNum.
Whitelisted trading address bypassing the ensure() gate.
Public balance mapping mutated directly with unchecked arithmetic.
Public nested allowance mapping mutated with unchecked subtraction.
Constant public decimals = 18 used for supply scaling.
Public total supply set once in the constructor.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Private privileged owner address controlling init, batchSend, delegate and setTradeAddress.
Caller address; driv es authorization checks and allowance/balance mutations.
Unchecked delegatecall to an attacker supplied address inside delegate(), executing arbitrary code in this contract storage.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath, plus _onSaleNum increment.
total = _value * _tos.length computed without SafeMath, allowing multiplication overflow.
ensure() short-circuits to true for a hard-coded whitelist (owner, router, derived pair, tradeAddress, canSale), letting privileged addresses bypass the sale condition gate.
